scope: All 17 v1 test cases where the checklist judge's final decision was right and DCV's was wrong (no case was the reverse except 1). Classified by reading the logged DCV traces (results/applicability/test_dcv.jsonl). Diagnosis only; DCV was not changed afterwards and v1 test results stand as reported.
conclusion: Every disagreement came from forcing a 9B model to fill a fixed slot schema; none came from the deterministic selection, arithmetic or flip logic given correct readings.
